text: The next day, the village of Luntian was even more lively. From the plaza, laughter and chatter echoed as people prepared for the gathering.

speaker: Mira
text: Leo, could you help Aling Rosa buy groceries at the market?

speaker: Mira
text: Thank you! We need food and drinks for tomorrow.

speaker: Mira
text: It's fine if you're nervous. But you can do this, Leo. Just some simple errands for now.

speaker: Mira
text: First, buy food and fruits. Next, choose fish and vegetables. Include some buko juice for drinks as well. And don't forget the color of the bag.
Leo nodded. For the first time, he would be walking to the market on his own.

speaker: Mira
text: Alright, I'll repeat it. Food first, then drinks, then choose the right color for the bag.
